name: WhatsApp Web To Go - Mobile Client for WhatsApp We
tagline: Access WhatsApp Web on your mobile device - send pictures, audio and video
blurb: WhatsApp Web To Go lets you access WhatsApp Web on your mobile phone or tablet.
description:
WhatsApp Web To Go lets you access WhatsApp Web on your mobile phone or tablet. It has full support for sending pictures, audio and video - with a clean and easy interface.

Free and without ads.

If you have problems, just send a mail or create a GitHub issue.

This app is in no way affiliated with WhatsApp Inc. The rights for WhatsApp and WhatsApp Web belong to WhatsApp Inc. This app is a private project to enable the use of WhatsApp Web on Android devices.
